# SelectionBar

A bar for bulk actions on selected items: it shows how many are selected, a clear button, "Select all N" and
your actions, and replaces the toolbar in place while anything is selected.

**Interaction**: when `count` becomes greater than 0, the bar fades in and rises slightly over the toolbar, which
fades out; both take the same space, so the content below does not move. With "reduce motion" on, they only
fade. Screen readers announce the count politely ("3 selected", "Selection cleared"). `Tab` reaches the clear
button, "Select all N" and the actions; `Esc` while focus is in the bar clears the selection. When the bar hides
while it has focus, focus returns to `returnFocus`, to the element that last changed the selection (such as the
checkbox of a row) or to the toolbar, never to the page body. Numbers use tabular figures and the format of the
locale.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Bulk actions on selected table rows, files in an image grid or messages; "Select all" across pages

## Import

```ts
import { SelectionBar } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Combine it with the `rowSelection` of a table: while rows are selected, the bar replaces the toolbar in place,
so the table does not move. "Clear selection" or `Esc` in the bar clears the selection and focus returns to the
checkbox used last.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<readonly Project[]>(PROJECTS)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly string[]>([])
  const archive = () => {
    setRows((list) => list.map((p) => (selected.includes(p.id) ? { ...p, archived: true } : p)))
    setSelected([])
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <SelectionBar
        count={selected.length}
        total={rows.length}
        onClear={() => setSelected([])}
        onSelectAll={() => setSelected(rows.map((p) => p.id))}
        toolbar={
          <Toolbar actions={<Button variant="primary">New project</Button>}>
            <Input.Search aria-label="Search projects" placeholder="Search projects" />
          </Toolbar>
        }
      >
        <Button icon={<Icon name="archive" />} onClick={archive}>
          Archive
        </Button>
      </SelectionBar>
      <Panel flush>
        <DataTable<Project>
          aria-label="Projects"
          rowKey={(p) => p.id}
          rows={rows}
          selectable
          selectedKeys={selected}
          onSelectionChange={setSelected}
          columns={[
            { key: 'name', title: 'Project' },
            { key: 'owner', title: 'Owner' },
            {
              key: 'archived',
              title: 'Status',
              render: (p) =>
                p.archived ? (
                  <Pill>Archived</Pill>
                ) : (
                  <Pill tone="success" dot>
                    Active
                  </Pill>
                ),
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Panel>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Selecting all results

With `total` and `onSelectAll`, the bar offers "Select all N" while only some of the results are selected, for
example the rows of the current page, and says "All N selected" once everything is selected.

```tsx
export function SelectAll() {
  const files = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `f${i + 1}`,
    name: `Sketch ${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.png`,
  }))
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly string[]>([])
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <SelectionBar
        count={selected.length}
        total={files.length}
        onClear={() => setSelected([])}
        onSelectAll={() => setSelected(files.map((f) => f.id))}
        toolbar={
          <Toolbar>
            <Input.Search aria-label="Search files" placeholder="Search files" />
          </Toolbar>
        }
      >
        <Button icon={<Icon name="download" />}>Download</Button>
      </SelectionBar>
      <Panel flush>
        <DataTable
          aria-label="Files"
          rowKey={(f) => f.id}
          rows={files.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE)}
          selectable
          selectedKeys={selected}
          onSelectionChange={setSelected}
          columns={[{ key: 'name', title: 'File' }]}
          footer={
            <Inline justify="end">
              <Pagination
                size="sm"
                current={page}
                pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
                total={files.length}
                onChange={setPage}
              />
            </Inline>
          }
        />
      </Panel>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Deleting with undo

Moving to the trash can be undone, so it runs right away and `useMessage().undoable` offers "Undo" instead of a
confirmation. When the bar hides after the action, focus moves to the toolbar because the rows are gone.

```tsx
export function UndoDelete() {
  return (
    <App>
      <FilesWithUndo />
    </App>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | Number of selected items. With 0 the bar is hidden and `toolbar` is shown in its place. | — | Yes |
| `total` | `number` | Number of all results (all pages), when known. With it, the bar says "All N selected" once everything is selected, and offers "Select all N" before that if `onSelectAll` is set. | — | No |
| `onClear` | `() => void` | Clears the selection: called by the clear button and by `Esc` while focus is in the bar. | — | Yes |
| `onSelectAll` | `() => void` | Selects all `total` results, for example all pages instead of the current one. The "Select all N" button is shown while `count` is less than `total`. | — | No |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode` | The toolbar shown while nothing is selected (usually a Toolbar with search and filters). The bar replaces it in place and both take the same space, so the content below does not move. Without it, the space is kept empty. | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Bulk actions on the right, usually Buttons; put destructive ones last with `tone="danger"`. Prefer actions that can be undone (with "Undo" in a message) over confirmations. | — | No |
| `returnFocus` | `() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined` | Where focus goes when the bar hides while it has focus (after "Clear selection", `Esc`, or an action that empties the selection), for example the table. By default, the element that had focus when the selection last changed (such as the checkbox of a row), otherwise the first focusable element of `toolbar`. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
